name: Hydrotreating (naphtha, diesel, VGO)
principle: Oil and hydrogen are heated and passed over fixed beds of CoMo or NiMo catalyst, where sulfur, nitrogen and oxygen are converted to H2S, ammonia and water and olefins and aromatics are partly saturated. Separators and an amine scrubber clean and recycle the hydrogen, and a stripper removes H2S and light ends from the product. Topsoe states ULSD below 10 wt ppm sulfur.

source.note: Topsoe diesel hydrotreating page, read 24 October 2026

suppliers.name: Topsoe
suppliers.product: TK-series BRIM and HyBRIM catalysts, HDS/HDA

advantages: Catalyst changes can extend cycle length or volume swell
limitations: Cracked feeds raise pressure and catalyst demands
